summary: Iteration 8 — Support chat + required profile photo + 4-step driver signup (year dropdown, SSN, Driver Agreement). Backend pytest 19/19 PASSED in 8.37s (/app/backend/tests/test_support_and_signup_v8.py). Frontend Playwright: customer + driver signup both enforce profile photo (testID 'photo-doc') with error 'Please add a profile photo.'; full driver 4-step flow completes end-to-end (make-select Toyota → model-select Camry → year-select 2022 → color/plate → license-input + ssn-input auto-formats '152456789'→'152-45-6789' + 3 DocumentField uploads via expect_file_chooser → 4th 'Driver Agreement' step shows scrollable terms + agree-checkbox; submitting without checking shows 'You must accept the Driver Agreement to submit your application.'; submit button label switches to 'Submit Application' on step 3; final submit lands on /(driver) with Pending badge + 'Application under review' card). Support chat works end-to-end for BOTH customer and driver: tapping testID 'contact-support' in /inbox POSTs /api/support/start, navigates to /chat/support-<uid>, chat header reads 'Getaride Support', sending a message stores the user msg and shows the auto-reply (e.g. 'We've received your message and a support specialist will follow up shortly.'). Support thread appears at the top of /inbox with a headset icon and 'Getaride Support' label. Backend asserts: photo required for ALL roles (400 'A profile photo is required.'), vehicle_year<2010 → 400 'Vehicle cannot be older than 2010.', SSN '000-12-3456' / '666-12-3456' / '999-12-3456' / '111-11-1111' / '123-45-6789' → 400 'The Social Security Number could not be verified.', agreed_terms=false → 400 'You must accept the Driver Agreement to continue.', valid driver register returns approval_status='pending' + only ssn_last4='6789' persisted (full SSN NOT in /admin/users payload), pending driver POST /driver/online → 403, /admin/conversations labels support thread with the user's name and driver_name='Getaride Support'+is_support=true. No critical/minor regressions found.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — recurring from earlier iterations; not blocking. Reference: shared theme/shadowSoft helper.
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on map overlays. Reference: react-native-maps usage.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in shared theme/shadow helper to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
(Optional/LOW) Move pointerEvents from props to style on map overlays to silence deprecation warning.

(Optional/cosmetic) public_user() still exposes driver-only fields (vehicle_make/model/year/license_number, now also ssn_last4/agreed_terms) for customer accounts (as None) — leaks schema; consider gating those keys on role=='driver'. Same comment carried over from iter6/7.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_ssn() correctly rejects area 000/666/9xx, group 00, serial 0000, all-same digits, and well-known placeholders 078-05-1120 / 219-09-9999 / 123-45-6789. Be aware this is FORMAT/STRUCTURAL only (no SSA existence check) — flagged as MOCKED in mocked_apis_list. Acceptable.

server.py /api/auth/register: ssn_last4 = (req.ssn or '')[-4:] is taken from the RAW input, so a hyphenated value like '152-45-6789' would store '6789' (correct). Frontend strips non-digits before sending — verified.

server.py /api/support/start uses ride_id 'support-<user_id>'. /rides/{ride_id}/messages auto-replies as sender_role='support' when ride_id.startswith('support-'). Inbox surfaces support thread at the top regardless of last-message timestamp via convos.insert(0, ...) — works, but it always shows at position 0 even if a regular ride convo is newer; acceptable per product intent ('pinned support').
auth.tsx step2 client-side SSN validation only checks 9-digit length; backend does the structural verification — good defense in depth.

DocumentField uses expo-document-picker; on web it programmatically opens a file chooser (no static input[type=file] in DOM) — Playwright must use page.expect_file_chooser to drive it (also relevant for any future test agents).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (customer signup + driver 4-step signup + customer support chat + driver support chat)

seed_data_creation: Created one fresh pending driver via UI: TEST_v8drv+a4e785@getaride.com / Drive1234 (Toyota Camry 2022 Silver, plate FLV8X1, license DLV8X1, SSN last4 6789). Currently approval_status='pending'. The pytest module additionally creates short-lived TEST_drv+<rand>@getaride.com / TEST_rider+<rand>@getaride.com per run. None of the seeded production accounts (rider/driver/admin) were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest module for this iteration is /app/backend/tests/test_support_and_signup_v8.py (re-runnable: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_support_and_signup_v8.py -v`). It uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Key Playwright tips for the new 4-step driver signup: DocumentField (testIDs photo-doc/license-doc/insurance-doc/registration-doc) does NOT expose a static input[type=file] on web — you must use `async with page.expect_file_chooser(): await page.click(testid)` then `await fc.set_files(path)`, and wait for `[data-testid="<id>-filled"]`. Year dropdown is testID 'year-select' (SelectField, list 2010..current). SSN field 'ssn-input' auto-formats digits to 'XXX-XX-XXXX' on typing. The Driver Agreement step 3 shows a scrollable terms box + testID 'agree-checkbox' and the submit button label flips to 'Submit Application'. Support chat: testID 'contact-support' in InboxList header → /chat/support-<uid>; chat header text is 'Getaride Support'; sending a message via testIDs chat-input/chat-send triggers an immediate server-side auto-reply (sender_role='support'). The customer (rider@getaride.com) and driver (driver@getaride.com) seeded accounts now have an active support thread after this iteration — if you need a clean inbox state, soft-delete via DELETE /api/inbox/support-<uid> or register a fresh user.
